copy.tagline: 自动验证数据质量,提前发现数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据管道,需要自动检查数据质量,避免坏数据流入下游。
copy.tagline_en: Catch data issues early with automated quality checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run data pipelines and want automated quality checks to catch issues early.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Great Expectations、dbt 测试和数据契约的写法帮你搭数据质量校验：建期望套件、写校验规则、跑检查点，并输出每张表的通过／失败报告。
howto.when: 当你要搭建数据质量管道、编写校验规则，或在团队之间建立数据契约时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude writes data quality validation for you: Great Expectations suites, dbt tests, and data contracts, runs checkpoints, and reports pass/fail per table.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build data quality pipelines, write validation rules, or set up data contracts between teams.

say_en.text: Create a Great Expectations suite checking order_id is non-null and unique
